title: Quantum sensing for gravity cartography
abstract: First outdoor demonstration of quantum gravity gradiometry for subsurface mapping. Achieves statistical uncertainty of 20 E (Eotvos, where 1E=10^-9 s^-2), surveys with 0.5m spatial resolution. Detects a 2-metre tunnel with SNR=8. Average sensitivity 466 E/sqrt(Hz). Demonstrates practical utility of cold-atom gravity sensing for engineering and security applications.
key_claims: Sensitivity: 466 +/- 8 E/sqrt(Hz), statistical uncertainty 20 E in 10 min
0.5m spatial resolution achievable in survey mode
First outdoor cold-atom gravity gradiometer field demonstration
